format: Acustra dense bank Rice-delta v1 + fixed ASCII85

freepats.creator: roberto@zenvoid.org for FreePats
freepats.policy: full native-rate files for every SFZ region intersecting MIDI 38-84

eastman.policy: 8 finger-plucked 3.000 s native-rate stereo slices beginning 20 ms before each pinned onset; 60 ms terminal half-cosine de-click fade
eastman.rootPolicy: late-sustain H1 fits used for settled tuning while retaining recorded attack glide

shinyguitar.aggregateMethod: SHA-256 over each UTF-8 POSIX path relative to the repository root, one NUL byte, then file bytes; paths sorted bytewise
shinyguitar.policy: all 272 acoustic-microphone (_1) sustain WAVs referenced by Programs/acoustic.sfz and intersecting MIDI 38-84; native full duration, PCM16 conversion without level normalisation, 60 ms terminal half-cosine de-click fade
shinyguitar.mappingPolicy: exact SFZ key and velocity ranges; deterministic four-way round robin
shinyguitar.rootPolicy: H1 spectral peak over a 2.000 s Hann window beginning 820 ms after each detected onset; boundary fits fall back to the median of valid RRs for the same root/layer; playback retains the captured attack glide
